messages.subject: Binding outputs example
parts:
Hi,

I was trying to play with the timeseries example in http://rstudio.github.com/shiny/tutorial/#building-outputs

I am using renderTimeSeries function and html from the example.

I have very simple js for this -

var timeSeriesOutputBinding = new Shiny.OutputBinding();
$.extend(timeSeriesOutputBinding, {
  find: function(scope) {
    return $(scope).find(".timeseries-output");
  },
  renderValue: function(el, data) {
    $(el).html(data);
  }
});

Shiny.outputBindings.register(timeSeriesOutputBinding, "test.timeseries");

But when I try the example out, I get -
Passing functions to 'renderTimeSeries' is deprecated. Please use expressions instead. See ?renderTimeSeries for more information.
Error in .subset2(x, "impl")$defineOutput(name, value, deparse(substitute(value))) :
  Unexpected list output for timeSeries1
Calls: <Anonymous> ... serverFunc -> $<- -> $<-.shinyoutput -> <Anonymous>
Execution halted

What am I missing?

messages.subject: Re: Binding outputs example
parts:
Sure -

library(shiny)
library(datasets)

renderTimeSeries <- function(expr, env=parent.frame(), quoted=FALSE) {
  # Convert the expression + environment into a function
  func <- exprToFunction(expr, env, quoted)
  
  val <- func()
  list(start = tsp(val)[1],
       end = tsp(val)[2],
       freq = tsp(val)[3],
       data = as.vector(val))
  
}

shinyServer(function(input, output) {
  output$distPlot <- renderPlot({
    
    if (input$goButton == 0)
      return()
    
    # Take a dependency on input$goButton
    #input$goButton
    
    # Use isolate() to avoid dependency on input$obs
    dist <- isolate(rnorm(as.numeric(input$obs)))
    hist(dist)
  })
  
  output$timeSeries1 <- renderTimeSeries(function() {
    ts(matrix(rnorm(300), 100, 3), start=c(1961, 1), frequency=12)
  })

})
